text.hi: किताब कहती है: सोचो तुम डॉ. दास हो। अपनी बहन को चिट्ठी लिखो कि घर कैसे ख़रीदा और बगीचे के लिए क्या सोचा है। ढाँचा: Shyamla Hills, Kolkata, January 15, 2003. Dear Meena, ... Yours affectionately, (नाम)।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: socho tum Dr. Dass ho. Apni behen ko chitthi likho ki ghar kaise khareeda aur bageeche ke liye kya socha hai. Dhaancha: Shyamla Hills, Kolkata, January 15, 2003. Dear Meena, ... Yours affectionately, (naam).
text.en: The book says: imagine you are Dr. Dass. Write to your sister about how you bought the house and your plans for the garden. Format: Shyamla Hills, Kolkata, January 15, 2003. Dear Meena, ... Yours affectionately, (name).

prompt.hi: चिट्ठी: मैंने शांति भवन नाम का एक घर ख़रीदा है।
prompt.hinglish: Chitthi: maine Shanti Bhawan naam ka ek ghar khareeda hai.
prompt.en: Letter: say you have bought a house called Shanti Bhawan.

steps.answer: I have bought a house called Shanti Bhawan.

steps.answer: People said that a ghost visited the house.

prompt.en: Letter: say the ghost was really a greedy man.

steps.answer: But the ghost was really a greedy man.

meaning.hi: पर भूत असल में एक लालची आदमी था।

steps.answer: I will plant a flower garden outside the house.
